responses.text: {appreciative} Lot of the mutants here found out about Jacobstown because of Neil. {rueful} Our isolation works against us sometimes. {Splits emotion in these lines.}

responses.text: Killing our Bighorners, shooting at the lodge, that sort of thing. It's getting hard to keep people from retaliating.

responses.text: {frowns, didn't consider this} Guess I can't say for sure if they're NCR. {Beat, shrugs} Whoever they are, they want us dead or gone.

responses.text: Doc's inside the Lodge.

topics.prompt: I'm looking for Doctor Henry.

responses.text: Was a resort Pre-War. I renamed it to Jacobstown after an old friend. Died a long time ago.
I figured us mutants needed a place to call our own. Town's far enough away from humans so they don't bother us much.
One of these days I'm hoping we can trade with the rest of the wasteland. No more fighting, just... get along.

topics.prompt: What's the history of Jacobstown?

responses.text: Was part of Super Mutant army, ran a town, walked the wasteland with a tribal. Now I'm here.

topics.prompt: I'd like to know about you.

responses.text: Long story, so here's the short version. The Master created the Super Mutants and Nightkin.
The Master thought he could unify everyone. No more differences, no more war. {Beat, raises an eyebrow} Didn't end well.

topics.prompt: Super Mutant army?

responses.text: {Nods} Town was Broken Hills. Bunch of Super Mutants, humans, and Ghouls all living together peacefully. {Beat} Well, most of the time.

topics.prompt: You were a mayor?

responses.text: We were looking for a {GECK} GECK to save the village of {uh-ROY-yo} Arroyo. Eventually, we did. Nuked an oil rig in the process.
We went separate ways after that. I went east into the Rockies, looking for other mutants like myself.
Don't know what happened to my friend. {Beat, slight smile} I've got a feeling it turned out all right in the end.

topics.prompt: Tell me more about the tribal.

responses.text: All right.

topics.prompt: Let's talk about something else.

responses.text: Bighorners. Good eating. And we can trade the hides. Got a lot of wild ones around here, so it's easy to restock the herd.

topics.prompt: How does the town support itself?

responses.text: Not looking to fight. That'll give NCR an excuse to come up here and wipe us out.

topics.prompt: Why can't you just take them out?

responses.text: Because of a promise. One I haven't been able to keep. The Nightkin all suffer from schizophrenia. It's the Stealth Boys they use, used to use.
Nightkin have a hard time being seen like normal folks. Can't stand it. A few already left to try and find more Stealth Boys.
Miserable situation. They either stay here and suffer, or dig up Stealth Boys and lose their minds. Not much of a choice.

topics.prompt: Why does Keene want to leave?

responses.text: That happens, there's a good chance other Nightkin will follow. It'll make it hard to get a cure to them.
{Wary} Worse, if Keene and the Nightkin tear up the Mojave hunting for Stealth Boys, people are going get killed.
Most humans can't tell the difference between mutants. Might come here looking for payback. {Should end with the tone of "Can't let that come to pass."}

topics.prompt: What happens if Keene leaves?

responses.text: Thanks.

topics.prompt: I changed my mind - I'll help you with your mercenary problem.

responses.text: {Keene alive} Smart, charismatic. Hell of a mean streak. Doesn't care for humans. Prefers fighting them to talking.

Keene is saner than most, but I know he's thinking of going his own way again. He's aggressive, impatient. Can't stand sitting around.

topics.prompt: What's the story with Keene?

responses.text: Such as?

topics.prompt: I had some questions about Jacobstown.

topics.prompt: Why do some of the Super Mutants here dislike the NCR?

responses.text: {contempt} {KAI-zar} Caesar thinks he can change human nature. Most of the Legion is following {KAI-zar} Caesar, not {KAI-zar} Caesar's ideals. When he's gone, it'll crumble.

topics.prompt: What do you know about the Legion?

responses.text: They expand, fast. If you've got land they want, they'll take it, eventually. Did it out West, they'll do it here.
{Warning tone to govt} They keep rolling over people, they'll regret it. That's how revolutions start.

topics.prompt: What makes the NCR too ambitious?

topics.prompt: Anything else can you tell me about the NCR?
